subject: Post-call: Finwise performance SLOs + customer-led load test coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Finwise performance SLOs + customer-led load test coordination

Thanks again for the call earlier, Alex - great alignment on where you want to validate performance before the April rollout. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan:

Summary of SLOs you asked us to qualify:
- P50 latency target: <= 120ms
- P95 latency target: <= 500ms (90% of calls must be under this)
- Sustained throughput: 1,000 req/s for the core /generate endpoint
- Burst concurrency: up to 200 concurrent streams/clients
- Streaming: must support chunked streaming for long responses (we'll validate both chunk frequency and connection stability)

Customer-led load test plan (your side runs the tests):
1) You provide k6/Locust scripts and a source IP CIDR list for allowlisting.
2) Redwood will provision a test account + ephemeral API key and open network access for the test window.
3) You run tests during an agreed window and share raw k6 summaries + .csv of response latencies; we'll run parallel internal monitoring.
4) Post-test call to review traces, KV cache hit rates, and any configuration changes (batching / quantization profiles) needed.

Ask from you today:
- Confirm the k6 script you'll run (attach or link) and whether you'll use multiple agents/regions.
- Provide source IP ranges for allowlisting.
- Confirm a 2h test window (we suggest 02:00-04:00 UTC on 2027-02-22) or propose an alternative.

We can provision a test API key and a dedicated test route (same model version as your prod pin) - tagging that key to this deal id (DW-2027-089). Logan / Aditya, can you take point on provisioning and the firewall rule?

Thanks - I'll sit on the post-test review.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Finwise SRE Team <sre@finwise.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finwise performance SLOs + customer-led load test coordination

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear summary. Confirming details from the Finwise side:

- We agree to validate the P50/P95 and 1,000 req/s throughput target. P95=500ms acceptable as the gate for this load test.
- We'll run a k6 script against the /generate endpoint (script attached as k6_smoke_test.js) from our internal performance lab (3 agents, east/us, west/us, eu/central).
- Source IP ranges for allowlisting attached (finwise_ip_allowlist.csv).
- Streaming requirement: we'll include a scenario that requests ~2.5-3k token outputs to validate chunked streaming.
- Proposed test window: 02:00-04:00 UTC on 2027-02-22 - confirmed unless Redwood needs a different time.

Deliverables we'll share after the run:
- k6 summary (stdout + JSON results)
- raw latency CSV and percentiles per endpoint
- a short replay of any failing traces (we can pull distributed trace ids)

Let us know the test API key and endpoint details when ready. We expect minimal infra changes but will coordinate if we see elevated timeouts.

- Alex
Alex Johnson
SRE Lead, Finwise
alex.johnson@finwise.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Finwise performance SLOs + customer-led load test coordination

Looping you in to provision the test artifacts Alex requested. Key checklist:
- Provision test account tied to deal id DW-2027-089 and create ephemeral API key (valid 48h).
- Create a dedicated test route that pins to the same model version Finwise uses in prod.
- Add firewall allowlist for IPs in finwise_ip_allowlist.csv (attached).
- Ensure logging/tracing is enabled for the test route and that we capture KV cache hit rate.
- Coordinate with infra to confirm capacity reservation during 02:00-04:00 UTC on 2027-02-22.

Aditya - can you confirm the runtime concurrency profile we should allocate for this test? Logan - please generate the test creds and post them once ready to the thread (or DM the creds to Alex if preferred).

Thanks,
- Marissa
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Finwise performance SLOs + customer-led load test coordination

Thanks - taking action. Plan and artifacts below:

1) Test creds & endpoint
- Test API key (ephemeral): finwise_test_key_20270222 (created, TTL 48h) - posted to Finwise via secure vault link.
- Test endpoint: https://api.redwood.test/finwise/dw-2027-089/generate (route pinned to v2027-02-10-prod-model)

2) Firewall/allowlist
- Added CIDRs from finwise_ip_allowlist.csv to the test route allowlist. Attachment: finwise_ip_allowlist.csv (stub).

3) Capacity reservation
- Provisioned a dedicated test pool scaled to handle 1,200 req/s sustained and 250 concurrent sessions for the 02:00-04:00 UTC window on 2027-02-22.
- Telemetry: traces + token-level latency metrics + KV cache hit-rate are enabled and will be exported to the temporary S3 bucket (link shared with Alex).

4) Ops notes for Aditya
- Set batching to default for this route, but we can disable batching if the customer wants a strict single-request path during the first run.
- Aditya: please confirm whether to enable pinned quantization profile (q8_compat) or leave model at baseline FP16 for this test.

Alex - I'll DM the vault link with the test key. If you prefer the key in-thread, we can paste it (we usually avoid that for security).

- Logan
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Finwise performance SLOs + customer-led load test coordination

Perfect - thanks for the fast turnaround, team. We received the vault link and the endpoint. We'll run the k6 scenario during the 02:00-04:00 UTC window tomorrow (2027-02-22). We'll share the JSON output and raw CSVs within 1h of test completion and then schedule a 30-45 minute review call for traces and tuning.

One quick note: we'll start with batching enabled (as you provisioned) and if we see systematic queueing we'll try a disable run to compare. We'll also include a streaming-heavy scenario to validate chunked responses.

Speak tomorrow - Alex
